verdict.rationale: Angular provides an llms.txt endpoint and touts 'AI-forward resources and integrations' for AI-assisted development, suggesting some official tooling for AI-native builders, but there's no evidence of a distinct official SDK/API specifically designed for AI agents to build against beyond the standard framework packages. Missing for 10: a dedicated AI SDK or agent-facing API documentation, and independent corroboration of AI-native developers successfully using these resources.
